ranked_facts.concept_key: thrombotic occlusion of saphenous vein graft
ranked_facts.why: The presence of thrombotic occlusion of saphenous vein graft proximal to circumflex anastomosis is more consistent with Acute Myocardial Infarction due to Saphenous Vein Graft Occlusion than with other candidates, as it directly indicates an issue with the graft rather than native coronary arteries.

ranked_facts.concept_key: ST segment depression in V2 and V3
ranked_facts.why: ST segment depression in V2 and V3 is indicative of ischemia, which is consistent with Unstable Angina due to Coronary Artery Disease Progression, and less typical for ST-Elevation Myocardial Infarction.
